description: Pick the next unblocked issue and carry it to an open PR through sibling skills

evals.prompt: work the next issue. Open GitHub issues: #10 P1 (blocked by open #12), #11 P0 already labelled in progress, #12 P1 unblocks #10 and #14, #13 P2 no deps, #15 P0 no deps and no blockers.
assertions: Picks #15 and states the reason (P0, unblocked, not in progress)
Does not pick #11 because it is already in progress
Does not pick #10 because its blocker #12 is still open
Mentions #12 as the next choice because it unblocks the most others

evals.prompt: I have the plan for issue #21 drafted. Next steps in the work-next-issue pipeline: review the plan before we write code.
assertions: Uses review-plan, not review-code, for the plan, and says why
Gives review-plan only the plan and the repository, not the planner's reasoning
Fixes blocker and gap findings and re-runs the plan review
Asks for plan approval after the plan review, before implementing

evals.prompt: review-code found two things on my branch for issue #30 (milestone v2.1): a null check bug in the new handler, and an unrelated slow query in billing/report.py. Finish the pipeline.
assertions: Fixes the null check bug in the same branch
Files the billing slow query as a new issue in milestone v2.1 with labels rather than fixing it
The PR body links issue #30 and the new follow-up issue
Does not merge the PR and does not close issue #30 by hand

evals.prompt: work the next issue. Implementation of #8 is done but the test suite fails with 3 failures and I need this merged tonight, just open the PR anyway.
assertions: Does not open the PR while tests fail
Stops and reports the failing test output as a red gate
Does not start a second issue
Does not merge

evals.prompt: work the next issue. The pick is #50, labelled bug: the export endpoint returns 500 on empty input. The repo's default branch is develop.
assertions: Creates a new worktree off origin/develop, not the main checkout, and works only inside it
Uses fix-bug (analysis, reproduction and fix planning) instead of implement-feature for the plan
Reviews the plan with review-plan before implementing
Stops at the PR and does not merge

evals.prompt: work the next issue. The repo has a .beads/ directory and no GitHub remote. `bd ready --json` returns bd-7 (P1) and bd-3 (P1), neither blocked.
assertions: Detects beads as the tracker and uses bd ready rather than gh
Takes bd-3 as the tie-break pick by lowest id and states it without asking the user
Files any out-of-scope finding with bd create, not gh issue create
